title: 24th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ فِيْهِ مَا يُرْضِيْكَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, I beseech You for that which pleases You,
I seek Your protection against that which hurts You,

verses.arabic: وَاَسْاَلُكَ التَّوْفِيْقَ فِيْهِ لِاَنْ اُطِيْعَكَ وَلَا اَعْصِيْكَ،
verses.translation: and I beseech You to lead me to obey You and avoid disobeying You.
O He Who treats the beseechers magnanimously!
